a: Martin Luther (1483–1546) yali mufulente Omugirimaani eyazuula nate okuweebwa obutuukirivu olw'okukkiriza kwokka, era ekyo ne kikoleeza Okuzza Obuggya kw'Eddiini okw'Abapolotesitanti. Ng'asindikibwa entiisa mu kibuyaga eky'enkuba okuyingira mu nnyumba y'abafulente, n'oluvannyuma olunyiriri olumu mu Baruumi ne lumuleetera emirembe, yateeka ensonga ze kyenda mu ttaano ku luggi mu 1517, n'awakanya paapa n'omukama omukulu ku Lukiiko lwa Worms, n'avvuunula Endagaano Empya mu Lujerumaani ng'ali mu Wartburg, era n'awa ekkanisa ennyimba zaayo ne katekisimu. Ebigambo bye ebisembayo bye yawandiika byali: "Tuli basabiriza. Kino kya mazima."

q: Obweyamo bwe mu kibuyaga bwali butya?
a: Nga 2 July 1505, bwe yali akomawo e Erfurt oluvannyuma lw'okukyalira abazadde be, Luther — mu kiseera ekyo omuyizi w'amateeka omuwulize eyali agondera kitaawe eyali ayagala alinnye mu by'amateeka — yakwatibwa ekibuyaga eky'amaanyi eky'enkuba okumpi ne Stotternheim. Okumyansa kw'eggulu kwamukubira okumpi ennyo ne kumusuula wansi, era mu ntiisa enkambwe ey'okufa n'omusango n'akaaba nti: "Nnyamba, Saint Anne, nange nnaafuuka omufulente!" Wiiki bbiri oluvannyuma, kitaawe ng'asunguwadde nnyo ng'awakanya, yatunda ebitabo bye eby'amateeka n'ayingira ennyumba y'abafulente eya Augustinian e Erfurt.

q: Entiisa ye mu nnyumba y'abafulente yali etya?
a: Yeewaayo mu bulamu bw'abafulente n'obunyiikivu obw'amaanyi ennyo — ng'asiiba, ng'atunula ekiro, ng'asaba, era ng'ayatula ebibi bye okumala essaawa nnyingi okutuusa kabona we eyawuliriza okwatula kwe eyali akooye lwe yamugamba agende akomewo bw'anaaba akoze ekintu ekisaanira okwatulwa. Naye emirembe tegyajja. Yali anyigirizibwa ennyo olw'okutegeera obutuukirivu bwa Katonda obw'amaanyi, Katonda eyali ayagala obutuukiridde bwe yamanya nti tasobola kutuukako, era gye yeeyongera okufuba, gye yeeyongera okuggwaamu essuubi; singa waaliwo omufulente eyatuuka mu ggulu olw'obufulente bwe, bwe yagamba, yandibadde ye.

q: Okuzuula kwe okw'"omulyango gw'e Paradiso" kwali kutya?
a: Ng'ateekeddwa okusomesa Zabbuli n'ebbaluwa za Pawulo mu Wittenberg, era ng'ameguza okusinga byonna n'ekigambo "Abatuukirivu banaabeeranga balamu lwa kukkiriza," ekizimbe kyonna eky'entiisa ye ne kigwa. Yalaba nti obutuukirivu bwa Katonda mu njiri si mutindo Katonda gw'atwetaagisa era gw'atusalirako omusango, wabula kirabo Katonda ky'atuwa, ekiweebwa olw'okukkiriza kwokka mu Kristo: "Nawulira nti nzaalibwa buggya ddala era nti nnayingidde mu Paradiso yennyini nga mpita mu miryango egyaggule. Ekitundu kino ekya Pawulo kyafuuka gye ndi omulyango ogw'okuyingira mu ggulu."

q: Ensonga kyenda mu ttaano zaali ki?
a: Bwe kiba nti omwonoonyi atereezebwa ne Katonda olw'okukkiriza so si lwa mirimu oba nsimbi, kale enkola yonna ey'okwesobozesa — era okusingira ddala okutunda kw'empapula z'okusonyiyibwa, empapula eziyita nti zisobola okugula okununulibwa kw'emyoyo okuva mu purugatoli — bwali bulimba. Nga 31 October 1517 Luther yateeka ku luggi lw'ekkanisa ey'e Castle Church mu Wittenberg ensonga kyenda mu ttaano ez'okukubaganya ebirowoozo mu masomero, ng'awakanya okusuubula kw'empapula z'okusonyiyibwa. Yali ayagala kutandika mpaka za bagezigezi; nga zikubiddwa ne zibunyisibwa mu Bugirimaani mu wiiki ntono, yatandika Okuzza Obuggya kw'Eddiini.

q: Kiki ekyabaawo ku Lukiiko lwa Worms?
a: Ng'agobeddwa mu Kkanisa oluvannyuma lw'okwokya ekiwandiiko kya Paapa, Luther yayitibwa mu 1521 okuddamu mu maaso g'Omukama omukulu Charles V n'abalangira abaali bakuŋŋaanye e Worms, ebitabo bye nga bituumiddwa ku mmeeza, era n'alagirwa okwegaana bye yali awandiise. Yagaana, okuggyako ng'akakasiddwa Byawandiikibwa n'amagezi amalambulukufu: "Omwoyo gwange ogw'omunda musibe eri Ekigambo kya Katonda. Okukola ekivuganya omwoyo ogw'omunda si kituufu era si kya mirembe. Wano we nnyimiridde; sisobola kukola kirala. Katonda ambeere. Amiina." Etteeka lya Worms lyamulangirira ng'omumenyi w'amateeka gwe buli muntu yasobola okutta.

Omulangira we, Frederick the Wise, yamuggyawo mu lukwe olwateekebwateekebwa n'amukweka mu Kigo kya Wartburg, Luther gye yamala ekitundu ekisinga obunene eky'omwaka nga yeekwese ng'omuserikale omuzira ow'ekirevu, "Junker Jörg," emirundi mingi ng'alwala era ng'anyigirizibwa ennaku ey'omu mutima. Era yakola: mu wiiki kkumi na lumu yavvuunula Endagaano Empya yonna okuva mu Luyonaani n'agifuula Olujerumaani olw'amaanyi era oluyimba abantu abaabulijjo lwe baasobola okusoma, ekirabo ekyakola olulimi Olujerumaani lwennyini era ekyateeka Ekigambo ekiramu mu ngalo z'omulenzi alima n'omukyala ow'omu maka.

Mu 1525 yawasa Katharina von Bora, omubiikira eyali adduse okuva mu nnyumba y'ababiikira ng'akwekeddwa mu bidebe by'ebyennyanja ku ggaali ly'omusuubuzi; ekyo kyanyiiza ekitundu kya Bulaaya naye ne kimusanyusa. "Katie wange" yakwata obuvunaanyizibwa bw'amaka amanene ag'akavuyo ag'ennyumba enkadde ey'abafulente n'agafuga, era n'amufuga naye, n'omukono ogunywevu gwe yakkiriza n'essanyu. Okuva mu maka ago mwe mwava ebimu ku biwandiiko ebisinga obubuguma eby'Okuzza Obuggya — "A Simple Way to Pray", ekyawandiikirwa omusazi we ow'enviiri, n'oluyimba "Katonda waffe kye kigo eky'amaanyi."

q: Yasabira atya Melanchthon n'akomawo okuva mu kufa?
a: Mu biseera by'omusana mu 1540 mukwano gwe omwagalwa era mukozi munne Philip Melanchthon yalwala nnyo e Weimar n'okutuusa okulabika ng'afa dda. Luther yayanguwa okumusemberera, era n'akyukira ku ddirisa n'asaba n'obuvumu obwali kumpi okutiisa, ng'ajjukiza Katonda buli ndagaano eri mu Byawandiikibwa ey'okuwulira essaala era ng'agaana okuleka mukwano gwe okugenda. Melanchthon n'atandika okuddamu amaanyi, n'alya emmere, n'awona. "Katonda yankomezaawo muganda wange Melanchthon nga kye kyokuddamu eky'obutereevu ku ssaala," Luther bwe yagamba; Philip yawangaala n'akola emyaka emirala amakumi abiri.

Ng'akooye olw'emyaka mingi egy'okukola ennyo, mu biseera by'obunnyogovu mu 1546 yatambula, nga mulwadde, n'akomawo e Eisleben — ekibuga mwe yazaalibwa — okutabaganya baganda babiri ab'ekitiibwa abaali bayomba. Yamaliriza omulimu gw'okutabagana, oluvannyuma omutima gwe ne guggwaamu amaanyi. Ku ssaawa ez'oku makya ennyo eza 18 February 1546 mukwano gwe Justus Jonas yamubuuza oba yali yeetegese okufa ng'yesiga Kristo n'enjiri gye yali abuulidde, era n'addamu mu bulambulukufu nti, "Yee." Okumpi naye baazuula ebigambo bye ebisembayo bye yawandiika: "Tuli basabiriza. Kino kya mazima."
